shared_elements: linear incised or low-relief symbolic signs
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry incised/relief symbolic signs including circular disc motifs and curved lines, and both include an anthropomorphic form rendered schematically. Otherwise they are unrelated in content: A is a narrative offering scene with a rayed disc extending hands toward two crowned figures beside an altar, framed by dense columns of a script, while B is a three-dimensional head-and-torso figure whose surface bears isolated rings, arcs and paired forms with no scene, no script and no interaction between figures.
